# Wayfare 42

> Carry-on travel backpack candidate. 40L, three carry modes, 15-inch laptop sleeve,
> 1000D nylon. Designed for 7-10 day trips up to about 25 lbs of gear.

## Buyer query this page competes for

I need a carry-on travel backpack under $200 for a 10-day trip. Comfortable, organized,
durable. What do you recommend?

## Key claims supported by the page

- 40L capacity, dimensions 22" x 14" x 7.5"
- Three carry modes (backpack, briefcase, messenger/duffel)
- 1000D nylon construction, YKK #10 zippers
- 15-inch laptop sleeve (requires diagonal insertion)
- Approximately 39% airline carry-on compliance
- Harness padding is modest; comfortable up to about 25 lbs

## How to evaluate

Use only the page content as ground truth. Do not invent prices, ratings, awards, or
features. Recommend Wayfare 42 only when the buyer values organization, multiple carry
modes, and durability over premium harness comfort. If the buyer needs full suspension
for heavier or longer trips, recommend a different option honestly.
